title.full: Applying for a CareShield Life claim

summary.text: If you are covered, apply through AIC’s eFASS portal using Singpass.

steps.name: Submit your application
steps.text: If you are covered under CareShield Life, submit your application through the Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) eServices for Financing Schemes (eFASS) Application Portal using your Singpass.

items: If you are covered under CareShield Life, submit your application through the Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) eServices for Financing Schemes (eFASS) Application Portal.
